item.title: Yoo Yeon Seok and Esom Face Off in Supernatural Legal Drama “Phantom Lawyer”
item.description: SBS has unveiled new still cuts from its upcoming Friday–Saturday drama Phantom Lawyer, highlighting the contrasting chemistry between leads Yoo Yeon Seok and Esom.
